explanation: CGI means computer-generated imagery. Jurassic Park (1993) mixed CGI dinosaurs with life-size animatronic ones built by Stan Winston's studio.

claims.text: The G in CGI does not stand for green, graded or guided.
Jurassic Park (1993) combined computer-generated dinosaurs with full-size animatronic dinosaurs built by Stan Winston's studio.
